finding: Root index.html is NFL-dated 2026-11-02 while root EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md is NBA-dated 2026-11-11, across 20+ mixed-domain subsites (nba-*, sf-rent-*, nfl-*).
impact: A reviewer landing on the root page sees two different sports and two different dates with no domain separation.

finding: All four NFL boards are frozen at 2026-11-02 and are missing 16 completed games (Week 8 MNF CHI@SEA plus all 15 Week 9 games).
impact: Every line, rating and leaderboard on those boards is computed on a stale ledger.

finding: README.md describes line-lab as a 'W1-9 game log' whereas games_2026.json holds 120 completed finals (Weeks 1-8) plus 16 unplayed 0-0 'scheduled' records.
impact: A reviewer trusting the README will over-count nine weeks of results.

finding: Backtest, correlation and luck/skill tables rely on third-party GitHub datasets (tobycrabtree/spreadspoke assuming a flat -110 price; brianfoshee/nfl-play-by-play-data).
impact: Leaderboard ROI and correlation values are not reproducible from any official source.

finding: ESPN/DraftKings ingestion dropped ties (NYG 4-2 and WSH 2-4 instead of 5-2-1 and 2-5-1), produced 3 malformed open-spread tokens, and truncated Super Bowl futures at 16 of 32 teams.
impact: Standings cannot reconcile to nfl.com; futures coverage is half the league.

finding: Prior Week 9 originators disagreed on HFA (+2.0 vs 0.0 with k=8 shrinkage vs Pythagorean) and omitted starter injury/IR adjustments entirely, pricing BAL as healthy with Lamar Jackson on IR; JAX won 33-10.
impact: Two different spreads for the same game, and the largest single-game error class is unmodelled.

finding: The official Week 10 injury table displays 'No Injuries Reported' for the Monday-night LAC@BAL game, because the report is in its pre-Thursday window and IR players are excluded from it.
impact: A naive reader concludes BAL is fully healthy; both BAL QB1 and QB2 are in fact on IR.

finding: Club depth charts carry 'unofficial' disclaimers, one is raster-only, several leave backup cells blank and several lag transactions.
impact: 2nd/3rd/4th-string identification cannot be fully automated or fully trusted from club pages alone.

finding: The cited operations.nfl.com 2017 injury-report policy URL returns HTTP 404.
impact: The claimed governance source cannot be opened by a reviewer.
